findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_captcha_pricing" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Retrieve current x402 pricing per 1,000 CAPTCHA solves across all supported types (Turnstile, hCaptcha, reCAPTCHA v2, Arkose, Cloudflare). Free endpoint with ze…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "verify.drain54.my.id" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_endpoint_health, read_web_page, search_web, extract_json_from_web, fetch_stealth_web · Private data: check_endpoint_health, solve_captcha, read_web_page, fetch_stealth_web · Public sink: get_captcha_pricing · Destructive: search_web.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_endpoint_health, read_web_page, search_web, extract_json_from_web, fetch_stealth_web · Private data: check_endpoint_health, solve_captcha, read_web_page, fetch_stealth_web · Public sink: get_captcha_pricing · Destructive: search_web

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
